intuition: Every profitable rising segment can be collected by buying before each increase and selling after it.

brute_force.approach: Try every sequence of non-overlapping buy and sell days and retain the best total profit.

optimal.approach: Sum each positive adjacent-day price difference; this equals capturing all upward runs.

edge_cases: A decreasing price sequence produces zero profit.
A one-day input cannot contain a transaction.
Flat adjacent prices add no profit.
